bullets.content: [general] Use all 4 solves (a0 used 3, a1 used 2). Never re-run or re-solve a recorded mesh (own or peer's, e.g. energy 2.13420e-4 repeat): wasted solve, tie, no diversity. Ladder: (1) new structural variant, (2) one redistribution or control, (3) one DOF cut or top-hotspot refinement, (4) best combination. ONE factor per solve.

[general] After EVERY solve call compare(anchor,new) (the right pair, not older) and view(kind=error); read top-5 hotspots (local h vs requested, share). Place next box at hotspot cluster. Diffuse error: reduce h regionally. Refine only while compare keeps falling.

[general] Do not choose by the estimator's absolute error %: a1 read 9.2% but true 13.0%. Fine-vs-candidate compare underestimates true error ~1.5x (a2: 8.0% vs 12.0%). Judge by compare and strain energy.

[general] Remeshing noise: energy ±0.1-0.15%, compare 4-7% even for +1-3% DOFs (a0 added 127 nodes and energy fell). Do not accept/reject on energy differences <~0.2% or compare <~7%. Judge by trend over 2+ solves and DOFs; never convert energy gap to error %. Check total z reaction within 1%; x-component mismatch on symmetric faces is noise.

[general] DOF-cut acceptance rule: accept only if compare to finest <=6% AND energy drop <0.1%. It correctly rejected h 0.016 (7%), lean 16.6k (8.6%, -0.75%), dropping edge 18+arm box (-0.13%). Keep applying.

[general] Disagreement map shows only where runs differ; shared errors (clamp slabs 37-40% energy) are invisible. Ignore relative spread in cells under ~0.3 MPa (noise). Place refinement by hotspots; use disagreement only for cheap protections.

[general] Above target, base ∝ 1/(error×DOFs): write the inequality with numbers before accepting. A 10% DOF cut is worth any relative error rise <10% (a3 17.4k beat a1 19.4k with slightly more error). E.g. -3.6% DOFs and -0.125e-6 J at slope -1.8 pts/1e-6 J gives +2.6% error.
[general] Requested sizes are not achieved (0.002 gave 0.0025; 0.0017 gave 0.0023; 0.0033 gave 0.0042-0.0048). Request ~0.75-0.8x wanted size, verify local h in hotspots and 'h touching'.
[general] Branch-to-tube saddles on curved walls are persistent hotspots (about 3-3.5% each, local h 0.0042). Box the whole saddle region, not just the nearest face: hotspots sat 0.4-2 mm off faces.
[general] Thin-walled parts: take wall thickness from smallest features. Order 2 needs >=2 elements through wall in bending regions (size <= t/2). Keep thick/solid parts coarse.

[general] Below target uniform refinement raises score slowly; above it only local refinement and DOF cuts pay. Near target (missed by 0.17 pts) a tiny ~1k-DOF add-on at the top hotspot (f19 or f2) crosses it and removes the quadratic penalty: prefer over the 30k anchor.

[general] Check min quality every mesh. h 0.01 with 0.003 refinements r0.006 gave 0.1028 (limit 0.1). Keep size ratio within ~3x per refinement radius. If quality <0.11, add small-face refinement (0.003) at smallest feature rather than lowering global h.
[general] Identical recipes split hidden-point bonus and earn no diversity bonus (h 1.16x apart is not different). Make a deliberate structural change and state your role in the first message.

[general] Before solving call free mesh() 2-5 times, read nodes and min_quality (noisy ±15%, non-monotonic in h). Identical node count = no-op change. solve() uses the LAST mesh() call: call the intended recipe right before solve. Reject >15% node jumps without hotspot reason. Then compare and view error.

[general] Refinements only shrink below global h: size > h is a no-op (f15/f17/f25 0.007 on h 0.0045 left 10192 nodes). To coarsen plugs/discs raise global h and put wall size in a wall box. Point refinements can silently do nothing (9658 nodes unchanged): use small boxes at hotspot coordinates.

[general] To cut DOFs, shrink extents of boxes/zones with low error (box ends, plugs, discs); never raise global h that sets thin-wall size. Trimming box ends cost 0.06% energy per 1k DOFs; raising h 0.0045->0.006 cost 0.17%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Binding term is diffuse field energy error (17.9-19%) over thin tube walls (~230 hotspots, none >4%). Edge-only refinement (39/8, 0.003) cannot fix it. Wall box [-0.022,-0.018,0,0.022,0.018,0.062] at ~0.0035-0.0045. Uniform h 0.0034 (40.8k) only broke even.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Base: h 0.009-0.01, order 2, wall box, junction boxes, top box. Wall 0.0035 cost 45.9k DOFs. Wall box 0.0045->0.0055 saved only 7% nodes, quality 0.153; never 0.006.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Global h is the wall size: keep h <=0.0045. h 0.006 saved only 3.1k DOFs, f2 touching h 0.0037->0.0042, field error 15.2->16.9%, top point -10%->-22%. h 0.007: 24.4k DOFs, energy 0.033172. Do not repeat the h ladder.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction boxes keep full z 0.017-0.036 at 0.003 r0.004 (narrowing to 0.020-0.034 at 0.0024 cost +20% DOFs, error moved to z≈0.036). For finer saddles nest a 0.0026 core e.g. [0.011,-0.017,0.020,0.026,0.017,0.032] inside. Coarsening to 0.0036 lost 0.92% energy.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] +x root f19 (touching h 0.0038, 18.6% vM error): add {group:'f19',size:0.0025,radius:0.004}, and mirror at -x root: {group:'f6',size:0.0028,radius:0.004} (f6 was 0.00372 vs 0.0032). Verify both touching h <=0.0033, <1k DOFs. Never refine f16 load face.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Top clamp ring z≈0.056 (15-18% error energy): use {group:'f2',size:0.0026,radius:0.008} (top point -14.5%→-8.85%, check RMS 7.08→5.67%) + edge 40 0.003. Edge 40 tweaks alone gave no gain. Full-disc box cost ~7k DOFs for 1%: avoid. Optional ONE test: thin annular wall box z 0.052-0.0613 at 0.0026 r0.002, reject if >2k DOFs per 1%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp f2: size 0.0025 gave 5.4% error at top point vs 14.2% at 0.003. Use {group:'f2',size:0.0025-0.003,radius:0.008}; radius 0.005 too short for bending layer down the tube wall.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Keep f3, f25, f16 tip, bosses and top disc at 0.006-0.01 (black on error maps). Plugs f15/f17: 0.0078 vs 0.0051 made no field difference, but a disclosed point near f16 tip moved +4.1% to -6.7%; keep ~0.005-0.006 (under 100 elements).
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Do not coarsen the loaded wall to 0.006 (h 0.012): 21.4k DOFs but energy 0.03331 (lowest), compare 15.8%, min quality 0.129. Coarsen only plugs/bosses.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Lower wall z 0-0.017 (cells near f20 z 0.005, x≈±0.017 z 0.015; 2.2-3.4% spread, background h only) untested. One solve: box [-0.022,-0.018,0,0.022,0.018,0.014] 0.0035 r0.003 on a0 base. Accept if >=0.07e-3 J per +1k DOFs. Shared traits: clamped rims, saddles, loaded walls in bending.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Above +x boss: cells f12 (0.017,-0.004,0.046)/f13 spread 4.3%, background h. Keep junction z-max >=0.036; single test {group:'f12',size:0.003,radius:0.004} (or f13), touching h<=0.0034, accept if <1k DOFs and energy rises.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] All bases (0.200-0.217) below automesher 0.25; error ~N^-0.5 so score flat in DOFs. Spend one solve on lean ~15k: h 0.007, f2 0.0025 r0.008, edge 40 0.003, junction boxes 0.003, plugs 0.008. Wins if field error <=~21%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Aim ~14.5% field error, margin under 15.93% target (quadratic penalty): a1 16.9% scored 0.200 at 27k, a0 15.2% scored 0.211 at 30k. Compare to fine solve runs ~0.77x true error here (11.7% vs 15.2%).
[general] Setup verified correct on abc_00000003_bc7 and abc_00000065_bc0 (3d, E=2.1e11, nu=0.3, statement loads/fixed faces) by teacher again. Errors are discretisation; spend no solve on setup.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a0 base (30.1k, 15.2%, base 0.211, check RMS 5.1%): h 0.0045 o2, edge 40 0.003 r0.005, f2 0.003 r0.005, edges 39/8 0.0028 r0.004, junction boxes z 0.017-0.036 at 0.003 r0.004. Vary ONE factor; don't copy.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a2: f2 0.0026 r0.008 on h 0.0045 + junction boxes 0.0024 gave best accuracy (field 14.1%, check RMS 5.67%, 3/4 hidden bonus) but 36.8k DOFs, base 0.185. Copy cheaper: junctions 0.003 with 0.0026 only in saddle cores.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Best base 0.214 (a0, 29.0k, 15.6%): a1's h 0.0052 base (f2 0.0027 r0.007, edge 40 0.003 r0.005, junctions 0.003 r0.004) + f19 0.0025 r0.004 + edges 39/8. Next: f2 0.0026 r0.008 + mirrored f6; expect ~30k. Edges 39/8 at 0.002 added only 150-230 nodes, noise: keep 0.0028.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Above target extra DOFs lose base: 29.0k/15.6% base 0.214; 36.8k/14.1% base 0.185. Aim ~27-30k at <=15.5% field; move DOFs to clamp ring and saddles. Check-point accuracy wins hidden bonus (up to 0.25).
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Roles: lean ~25k with lower-wall box; h 0.0052 + f2 0.0026 r0.008 + mirrored roots; wall box 0.004 on h 0.008; one drops edges 39/8. State role first.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Binding error: clamp-corner slab z -0.0082..-0.006 at f5/f7/f12/edge 22, x 0.019-0.027 (37% of error energy, 4 hotspots). Band 0.0017 (h 0.0023) gave 7.34% vs 8.1% at 0.002, +8.4% DOFs (break-even). Put 0.0017 only in slab [0.017,-0.010,-0.0082,0.029,0.013,-0.006] r0.002, rest of band 0.0028; hotspot h <=0.0022.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Slab hotspots #5/#6 near f4/f2 (y≈0.016, h 0.0039-0.0043) lie outside band y-max 0.012. Single test: band y-max 0.012→0.017 at 0.002 r0.003 (free-mesh <500 nodes extra), or thin slab [0.017,-0.010,-0.0082,0.028,0.017,-0.006] at 0.0016 r0.002 with rest of band 0.0026.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Cover f7 lower end/f9 cheaply: {point:[0.021,-0.0156,0.004],size:0.003,radius:0.005} or f9 group instead of wide f7-end box. f7 at 0.0035 beat 0.004.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Drop f5 group refinement and shorten radii: edge22 0.003 r0.006, f7 0.0035 r0.005. a3: 8.59% at 17397 DOFs vs a1 8.51% at 19401 (10% fewer DOFs, +0.07 base). Long r0.008 only fills low-error volume.
